notes: Model registry for a CPU-only PC with about 8 GB RAM (no NVIDIA GPU). Used by test-console/modes/ollama-cpu-8gb.json; config/local-models.json stays the GPU PC's registry. Same format and rules as config/local-models.json. Sizing: numCtx 8192 keeps the context memory small (qwen2.5:3b loaded at 2.2 GB with context 4096 on this PC, measured 2026-10-21; eval 11.65 tokens/s). maxOutputTokens 2048 keeps a worst-case answer under the 280 s attempt limit at about 11 tokens/s; it must be the same for every model. The R1 model spends output tokens on thinking, so with 2048 it may sometimes return an empty answer: use it for quick tests only. deepseek-r1:8b is left out: too large for 8 GB RAM.
